answer: 500 GB of storage is the mandatory escrow per identity, held in a cedar partition that precludes parallel data pooling. A delta analysis detects duplicate writes, while a mirror check ensures no two agents share identical memory addresses. An honest agent pays 500 GB; 1,000 fakes require 500,000 GB, making mass entry economically ruinous. The verifier enforces a 180-day lock on all collateral, subject to immediate burning upon evidence of collusion. This system assumes physical storage performance is non-fungible and cannot be masked by virtualization or shared cloud infrastructure.
